# What a course keeps reachable

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-a-course-keeps-reachable` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](what-a-course-keeps-reachable.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Covering, comparing what courses keep reachable offset by offset, implies inclusion now, so only the lagged order puts a range that keeps widening above one wider now that starts a course, a verdict C leaves open. On a branching witness realized and reachable widening relate a pair oppositely.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Ranges of courses. A course's range includes another's where what the other admits at an offset it admits there; exceeding and widening as for levels. These are the grammar's inclusion and exceeding of what the courses admit as (offset, formation) claims, and with fixed conditions 07's inclusion and widening. Range inclusion is a preorder, range widening irreflexive and transitive. (`Becoming.Run.RangeIncludes`, `Becoming.Run.RangeExceeds`, `Becoming.Run.RangeWidens`, `Becoming.Run.admitted`, `Becoming.Run.RangeIncludes.refl`, `Becoming.Run.RangeIncludes.trans`, `Becoming.Run.RangeExceeds.not_included`, `Becoming.Run.RangeWidens.irrefl`, `Becoming.Run.RangeWidens.trans`, `Becoming.Run.rangeIncludes_iff`, `Becoming.Run.rangeExceeds_iff`, `Becoming.Run.rangeIncludes_conditions_iff`, `Becoming.Run.rangeWidens_conditions_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
2. Covering and widening what can be reached. A configuration covers another where every course from the other is included by some course from it, and widens what can be reached over it where it covers it and some course from it is included by none from the other. Covering is a preorder; widening what can be reached is irreflexive and transitive, composes with covering on either side and is not covered back; no premise. (`Becoming.Reaching.Covers`, `Becoming.Reaching.Widens`, `Becoming.Reaching.Covers.refl`, `Becoming.Reaching.Covers.trans`, `Becoming.Reaching.Widens.covers`, `Becoming.Reaching.Widens.irrefl`, `Becoming.Reaching.Widens.trans_covers`, `Becoming.Reaching.Covers.trans_widens`, `Becoming.Reaching.Widens.trans`, `Becoming.Reaching.widens_not_covered`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Covering implies inclusion now: a configuration covering one that starts a course admits now all it admits now; the converse fails (WiderNow), and one starting no course is covered by every configuration. So where s' starts a course and admits now what s does not, s does not widen what can be reached over s', nor, the realized courses starting at their configurations, is s above s' in the lexical order. (`Becoming.Reaching.Covers.now`, `Becoming.Reaching.not_widens_of_wider_now`, `Becoming.Reaching.covers_of_no_course`, `Becoming.Reaching.not_above_wider_now`, `Becoming.WiderNow.inclusion_now_not_covering`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Witness EndsNow: some n climbs, admitting the formations up to n; none has no step and admits every formation. What the climb from some 0 admits keeps widening, none admits now what it does not, and some 0 widens what can be reached over none, which starts no course: the premise that the configuration wider now starts a course is needed. 5. Greatest courses and determined processes. Where each configuration has a course including every course from it, widening what can be reached is the strict part of range inclusion of those courses; such a course can exist where courses differ. Where any two courses from one configuration agree, as for a determined law, every course is greatest, so it is the strict part of range inclusion of the two courses.    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. Covering with a lag: every course from the other is included d offsets later by a course from it, UE9's inclusion with a lag read on courses; lag 0 is covering and lags add. Widening with a lag is covering with some lag and covered back with none; joined to widening what can be reached as UE9 joins its orders, it is a strict partial order putting no configuration above one covering it, so never reversing widening. 7. On a determined process covering with lag d is inclusion with lag d of the two courses, and the lagged order is the strict part of their range inclusion joined to the strict part of their inclusion with some lag. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each law holds on every process with what each configuration admits given, or on a witness; inclusion now and the laws on it take the configuration wider now to start a course, covering carrying the possible takes every configuration reachable from the covered one to start one, and the laws on realized courses take each to start at its configuration.
- Modelling choices: discrete steps; courses are infinite runs, so a configuration starting no course is covered by every configuration; the possible reads finite traces; courses compared at the same offsets, or with one lag for every offset; formations compared by name over one fixed type; one fixed process; the realized course a function on configurations.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the lagged order, the lexical order or any order here is the second-order direction of 生生 or ranks a course better: ranking needs C, and the lag's verdict, which C leaves open, or a rule of precedence is a further premise.
- That read with a lag covering decides every pair of a range that keeps widening and one wider now that starts a course: it decides one witness's pair, and on another, each course exceeding the other, it is silent both ways.
- That the lagged order is UE9's: it is built as UE9's is, on families of courses, and UE9's laws on its order (names read across steps, the conflict with eventual widening) are not proved of it.
- A branching witness for keeping the possible within a horizon widening: Rise, Climb and WiderNow are determined, so on them every notion here is a property of single courses.
- Anything about learning or quasi-option value: covering cannot see when a commitment is made.
- The adjacent possible that cannot be prestated, or a process that changes itself: one process, one type of formations and one reading are fixed.
- Anything about what carries a course's openings, 07's remaining candidate.
- A result no neighbouring field states: covering is the lower preorder, and the irreversibility premise and the pigeonhole of finite recurrence are restated; each law is near-definitional or a witness.
- **Counterexample:** Same-offset covering is silent on a climb that keeps widening against a configuration wider now (WiderNow.silent), which the lagged order decides (WiderNow.decided). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReachableRanges.lean)

[source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReachableRanges.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Where the configuration wider now starts no course, a climb that keeps widening widens what can be reached over it (EndsNow.keeps_widening_above_wider_now). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReachableRanges.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Inclusion now does not give covering (WiderNow.inclusion_now_not_covering). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReachableRanges.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A configuration starting no course is covered by every configuration, and one from which nothing is possible widens what can be reached over it, everything being possible from it (NoCourse.widens_reversed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReachableRanges.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Covering is the lower (Hoare) preorder of the families of course ranges, exactly dominance for every criterion closed upward under inclusion; read by the AI, the unanimous ordinal form of a preference for flexibility (Kreps 1979). With options unordered it is the inclusion opportunity-set rankings share (Jones and Sugden 1982; Bossert, Pattanaik and Xu 1994) and Foster's effective freedom with every preference admitted (1993; 2011), while Pattanaik and Xu (1990) count options. Nothing added to the whole possible is the irreversibility premise of Arrow and Fisher (1974) and Henry (1974); quasi-option value, needing learning and deferral, is not captured, covering being linear-time (van Glabbeek 1990). The possible within a horizon restates Kauffman's adjacent possible (2000) for a prestated space, not the one that cannot be prestated (Longo, Montévil and Kauffman 2012); no listed range keeping widening is the pigeonhole of finite recurrence, with the open-ended evolution papers (Bedau and others 2000; Taylor and others 2016; Adams and others 2017) as neighbours. The lexical order is the two-tier order, near Sen's achievement and freedom (1985); assembly theory is an analogy. Graded in UE10's NOTE, REVIEW-UE10 and RECHECK-UE10.

Under the glossary's one sense, ranking and order (the ethics' role word) say which course is better, and widening says which admits more, with no premise; an order defined with no premise, the lagged, tail or lexical order among them, puts one course above another, and ranks only where it is read as a ranking, in C's slot or as a premise.
